checks.evidence: The 1-second read works (full_720.jpg, thumb_200.jpg): '1 Sa shpenzove' in heavy ivory with the 1 in a crimson box, over a POS terminal and a receipt on a bar counter, red-cased phone in front. Sound off it reads 'number 1: how much you spent'.

Matches alt text 2: POS terminal and receipt on a counter (tile_r2c1.jpg, region_SL02_receipt_2x.jpg), 'Numri 1: Sa shpenzove'. The subline names what counts as spend (ads, video, people, tools), which fits the caption's line 1.

No invented number on a screen or paper: the POS screen is blank and dark, the receipt is blank paper with no print (region_SL02_receipt_2x.jpg), the phone screen is dark. The only figures are the list index '1' and the counter '2/7'. Keypad digits are key labels, not data (see V11). No price, result, client or em dash.
No people, hands or limbs in any of the 9 tiles.
No hands; still life.
No faces.

Everything rests on the counter: the POS sits on its base with a contact shadow, the receipt lies curled with its lower sheet flat on the wood, the phone lies flat with its reflection in the varnish (tiles r2c1, r2c2, r3c2).

Structures are right: the POS has a screen, a 3-column key grid and a red/yellow/green function row; the phone has the port and two speaker grilles on the bottom edge and a side button on the long edge (tile_r3c2.jpg, tile_r3c3.jpg). Key labels are covered under V11.

Read letter by letter at 2x. Kicker (region_SL02_kicker_2x.jpg): N-U-M-R-I / I / P-A-R-Ë, two dots on the Ë. Headline (region_SL02_headline_2x.jpg): [1 in crimson box] S-a / s-h-p-e-n-z-o-v-e = 'Sa shpenzove' as in the alt text (no final full stop on the slide, house style). Subline (region_SL02_subline_2x.jpg): R-e-k-l-a-m-a, / v-i-d-e-o, / n-j-e-r-ë-z, / m-j-e-t-e: / g-j-i-t-h-ç-k-a // q-ë / p-a-g-o-v-e / p-ë-r / k-l-i-e-n-t-ë / t-ë / r-i-n-j. All ë have two dots, the ç has its cedilla, punctuation is comma, comma, comma, colon, full stop. No misspelling, no em dash.

The text is the house overlay, set on the calm dark wall area left of the window (region_SL02_headline_2x.jpg, tile_r1c1.jpg). Nothing in the scene sits in front of a letter and no letter is painted onto a prop, skin or cloth.

Pre-existing (identical in v1). The POS key labels are garbled (region_SL02_pos_keypad_3x.jpg): the digit keys read 1, 3, 3 / 4, 8, 8 / 1, 8, 0 instead of 1-2-3 / 4-5-6 / 7-8-9, each with tiny pseudo-letter sub-labels, and the red, yellow and green keys carry gibberish glyphs. Only readable when zoomed (digits are about 15 px tall); at phone size it reads as a keypad. No other unwanted text: receipt and screens are blank, no signage in the window.

The story props are present and readable: POS terminal (left third), receipt (centre), red-cased phone (front). The receipt is deliberately blank (brand rule: no invented numbers on paper); it still reads as a till slip next to the POS.
The thread prop matches the style bible: smartphone in a deep red case (lit case near #BE0F18 family), dark screen. No prop sheet exists for the POS; it is a generic unbranded terminal.
The extra props (a cup of straws and a chair back at right, tile_r2c3.jpg) belong to a bar counter and do not compete with the story.
No characters, so no character sheet applies.
Phone state fits the thread: face up, screen dark (silent), between the cover's face-down phone and slide 3's message screen.
Same set as the cover: wooden table by the tall window, Tirana plaza at night with the clock tower in the right third (tile_r1c3.jpg).

1080x1350 (4:5). Kicker y62-80, headline and subline inside x96-762 with 96 px left margin; counter '2/7' at x933-979, y52-78; arrow at x931-989, y1233-1292; logo at x96-391, y1217-1274 (bottom margin 76 px). All key content sits inside the 4:5 frame and the 3:4 grid crop. The logo centre (y1245.5) sits 17 px above the arrow centre (y1262.5); a set-level placement issue, see SET review.
At 200 px wide the headline '1 Sa shpenzove' and the crimson box read clearly; POS, receipt, red phone and clock tower are recognisable. Not a hero slide; checked anyway.
Still life with no people in the scene; the window background is alive enough for the format (street lamps, lit facades, wet plaza with reflections, out-of-focus cars), the same on every slide.

Matches the style bible: Tirana at night through the window, warm tungsten grade, near-black wall, ivory type (#FAF7F2 measured), crimson number box (#B50E16 measured vs #B31217), crimson arrow (#9F0717), gold only in the counter (#CF9D49) and in the real logo's gold square, red-cased phone.
Photoreal night interior: wood grain with specular highlights, bokeh street lights, wet plaza, fine grain (tiles r2c3, r3c2). No plastic or CG look.

Caused by the fix. Where v1's drawn wordmark sat below the new logo, the fill is a smooth patch (region_logozone_fixed_2x_plain_and_inpaint_outline.jpg, region_logozone_clahe_orig_top_fixed_bottom_2x.jpg, region_logozone_band_orig_top_fixed_bottom_3x_gamma07.jpg): high-frequency texture std 0.46 inside vs 2.23 in the untouched ring around it, and 7 levels darker (17.7 vs 24.7), so the wood grain stops in a soft dark band under 'StraightScale'. A small bokeh highlight at (375,1200) was also softened (region_speck_1200_orig_left_fixed_right_8x.jpg). Visible at 2x and 3x, not at 1x or phone size; no seam line, no colour blotch, no ghost letters. Outside the logo zone the file differs from v1 only by JPEG re-encode noise (max 27 levels, mean 1.1; diffmap_orig_vs_fixed.jpg).

Logo is the real file (../SET/ref_logo_vs_pasted_all_slides_3x.jpg, region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg): red rounded square with the S-shaped channel, gold square in the top-right notch, white 'StraightScale' wordmark, identical to /home/user/brand/straightscale-logo-light.png. Fitting the real file at 295x57 at (96,1217) gives a mean absolute difference of 7.18 levels over its opaque pixels (the same 7.1 to 7.2 on all seven slides, i.e. one file at one scale); the opaque extent measures 291x54 px (aspect 5.39) vs the file's alpha bbox 1501x279 (5.38), so it is undistorted; edges crisp at 3x. No remnant of the v1 drawn logo: the plain white 'S' block and the drawn wordmark are gone, no ghost letters, no red or gold fragment in the cleared area (0 red and 0 gold pixels outside the pasted logo in the change zone; boosted and CLAHE views show only wood grain). No other brand's mark anywhere: the POS terminal, phone or cup carries no maker logo.
No before and after, no 'your [condition]', nothing that shames; the copy is a neutral instruction.

No AI person in the frame. Photoreal AI scene: STANDARDS.md section 7 asks for Instagram's own AI label on the post (a posting setting, not visible in the image); no burned-in AI tag is present, which is correct.

optional_edits: When the logo is re-placed for the G-SET fix, refill x98-390, y1267-1297 with texture-preserving inpainting (patch-based or a texture transfer from the wood grain directly above/right), not a smooth fill, then re-check HF texture against the surrounding ring.
Optional edit pass on the POS keypad labels (1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9 / * 0 #) if the slide is regenerated for another reason.

notes: Set-level finding (see SET.v2.logofix.review.json): the real logo is the same file and size on every slide but its vertical position varies by 50 px across the set (y1189 to y1239). The G-SET fix re-places the logo at one fixed box on every slide; each re-placed file is a new version and needs its own review.

No new hosted URLs for slides 2 to 7 were in the packet or the repo. hosted.json still lists the v1 originals: in the sandbox, each hosted.json URL downloads byte-identical to the v1 original (md5 match), not to the fixed file. Point the hub at the fixed files' URLs and md5-check them against reviewed_file before posting.
